description:
No spec subject (throwaway validation instrument; the production consumer of the ancora.tasks --json contract)

Stage: M1 (05b-stages-migration.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
In the ancora repo: scripts/replay/ (throwaway; deleted in M10) with a self-test first: builds a synthetic two-commit fixture repo in tmp (git init), one commit a hand-constructed interface-drift change, one formatting-only; must report drift on the first and clean on the second or refuses to run the real set. Consumes mix spec.check --json, never grepped human stdout. Exit states: 0 bar met, 1 bar failed, 2 harness/parse error. Bar (AR8): every selected drift PR yields at least one derived/drift naming a function the PR changed; the control yields zero findings at warning and above in derived/* and change/* with derived/unresolved_calls and format/retired_construct excluded by name. Mechanics: squash-merge PRs replay as head=S base=S^; git worktree add in the consumer repo; overwrite the worktree .spec/config.yml with a minimal ancora config; run mix spec.check --root <worktree> --base <base-sha> --json from the ancora checkout; no compile step in the worktree; run under the Elixir version the target .tool-versions names. Noclobber-safe writes with postcondition asserts. scripts/replay/SELECTION.md: ~5 Atlas/Builder PRs where a public function body changed in lib/, a @tag spec: test calls it directly, no .spec/specs/ edit in the PR; the vzd.4 shared-helper fan-out class excluded by rule; control = one plain mix format PR, never --migrate. bench/gate_bench.exs: runs mix spec.check --root <pinned-atlas-checkout> --base <pinned-base> three times via System.cmd, reports median wall clock; Atlas commit pinned at migration start; includes the ETS copy-semantics note; noclobber-safe. Record (not build) the AR10 CI perf test re-entry blueprint in the script header.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: the harness self-test (both verdict directions) passes; bats or ExUnit test for exit-state classification
- Behaviors to demonstrate: self-test drift commit yields exit 0 bar met on a one-PR set; formatting commit as sole drift PR yields exit 1; unparseable JSON yields exit 2
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: run the self-test only
  - Final tier: self-test plus one real PR from SELECTION.md end to end
  - Verifier tier: self-test and exit-state tests only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: the harness is the production caller of spec.check --json; proving test is the self-test
  - Fixture hygiene: synthetic repos in tmp; no compile in worktrees; noclobber writes
  - Spec surfaces: n/a (scripts outside lib/)
  - Every conditional clause covered (three exit states)
- Call-site Integration: the harness is the production caller of mix spec.check --json; the self-test is its proving test.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/**, test/** (nothing in the library changes here)
- .spec/**
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- scripts/replay/**, bench/**, SELECTION.md

Out of Scope (intent):
- no detector changes; a harness failure is debugged against the self-test before touching lib/
- no compile step in consumer worktrees
- PR selection may start in parallel with library work (archaeology, not code)

Merge gate:
- [ ] Self-test passes in both directions
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted (scripts are .exs)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
